description: Build an adapter loader service that integrates the trained ZoMesh LoRA adapter (Qwen2.5-3B + student_v1 from rob531/zomesh-sentinel-sft GitHub adapters/student-v1) into the inference router as a mesh_specialist tier. Loads adapter at startup with peft.PeftModel.from_pretrained. Exposes /generate POST endpoint on port 8793 (FastAPI + uvicorn). Routes task_type=sentinel_assess to the adapter; falls back to MiniMax if adapter inference exceeds 10s or errors. Logs adapter latency per request to mesh_memory.
